function createProject(root: string, path: string, title: string): void {
  const directory = join(root, path, '.decision-os');
  mkdirSync(directory, { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(join(directory, 'state.json'), JSON.stringify({ ledgers: [{ id: 'specs', title, ledgerFile: '.decision-os/specs.json' }] }));
  writeFileSync(join(directory, 'specs.json'), JSON.stringify({ cards: [{ id: `${title}-card`, title }], annotations: [], relationships: [] }));
}

Usage: ledger-cli <command> [options]

Commands:
  help
      Show this help text.

  overview --ledger <file>
      Print a compact card and relationship overview.

  card-context --ledger <file> --card-id <id> --json
      Print full card metadata, content file paths, relationships, and owning zone.

  session-context --ledger <file> --card-id <id> --json
      Print the target card, thread, zone, direct links, linked statuses, and lifecycle validation.

  master-task-gate --ledger <file> --card-id <id> --json
      Print one closeout decision with every linked-card discrepancy.

  master-task-complete --card-id <id> [--ledger <file>]
      Complete and Git-commit one master task through the running Decision OS server.
      Uses DECISION_OS_LEDGER_FILE, DECISION_OS_SERVER_URL, and DECISION_OS_PROJECT_ID from the skill runtime.

  master-task-apply --ledger <file> --plan-stdin
      Atomically apply a JSON master-task plan and generate every card and relationship id.
      Input: {"masterCardId":"card-id","title":"Title","zoneTitle":"Zone","sections":[{"title":"Finding","markdown":"1. **State:** ..."}],"subtasks":[{"title":"Task","sections":[{"title":"Scope","markdown":"1. **Objective:** ..."}]}]}
      The existing lifecycle header, timestamps, and geometry are preserved.

  master-task-progress --ledger <file> --plan-stdin --json
      Atomically update master/subtask content and labels, mark verified subtasks, append one reply, and return the gate.
      Input: {"masterCardId":"card-id","updates":[{"cardId":"card-id","sections":[{"title":"Result","markdown":"1. **State:** ..."}]}],"verifiedSubtaskIds":["card-id"],"reply":"Agent reply."}
      This command cannot complete the master task.

  execution-profile --ledger <file> --json
      Print project-scoped commands and server policy.

  codex-run-audit --root <catalog-root> --count <n> [--cutoff <epoch-ms>] [--exclude <run-id>]
      Audit the newest runs across every catalog project with latency when telemetry exists.

  codex-run-events --run-id <id> --item-type <type> [--limit <n>] [--root <catalog-root>]
      Return only the requested normalized events from one catalog-owned Codex run.

  zone-cards --ledger <file> --zone-id <id> --json
      Print cards owned by a zone with ids, titles, statuses, geometry, and content file paths.

  unanswered --ledger <file> [--json]
      List threads whose latest meaningful note still needs an agent answer.

  validate-master-tasks --ledger <file> [--card-id <id>]
      Validate one scoped JSON master-task contract, or every master task when no card id is supplied.

  answer --ledger <file> --thread-id <id> (--message <text> | --message-file <file> | --message-stdin)
      Append a short agent answer to a thread content file.

  mutate --ledger <file> [--mutation <file>] [--card-id <id>] [card options]
      Persist targeted ledger edits.

  export --ledger <file> --output <file.md>
      Export a ledger to Markdown.

  done --ledger <file> --card-id <id>
  todo --ledger <file> --card-id <id>
      Update a card status.

  skills create --source <skill-directory> [--json]
  skills update --source <skill-directory> [--json]
      Synchronize an OpenAI-format skill with the current server root and commit it.

  assets list-referenced --root <workspace> [--json] [--include-risky ui-mockups]
      List managed media assets referenced by decision-os text state.

  assets list-orphans --root <workspace> [--json] [--include-risky ui-mockups]
      List managed media assets not referenced and not pinned.

  assets gc --root <workspace> --dry-run
  assets gc --root <workspace> --write-plan .decision-os/assets-gc-plan.json
      Report or write a deletion plan for unreferenced media and unused decision-os text files from active state.json roots.
      Git-ignored paths are excluded from GC plans.

  assets apply-gc-plan --root <workspace> --plan .decision-os/assets-gc-plan.json
      Delete exactly the files listed in a previously written asset GC plan.

  assets prune-json --root <workspace> [--domain <name>] --dry-run
  assets prune-json --root <workspace> [--domain <name>] --write
      Remove stale imageSizes entries whose images are not present in Markdown.

  assets stage-referenced --root <workspace> --domain <name> [--include-risky ui-mockups]
      Git-stage decision-os text state and referenced managed media for a domain.

  migrate-decision-os --root <workspace> [--dry-run] [--write] [--json] [--allow-dirty]
      Rename a legacy workspace directory and rewrite decision-os storage refs.

2. Split the action into **Complete manually** and **Complete with pipeline** on the shared desktop/mobile surface.
3. Manual completion preserves the existing atomic master/subtask mutation.
4. Pipeline completion queues the configured server pipeline against the active master card and navigates accepted work to Exec.

5. The full backend suite retained four unrelated existing pipeline-catalog/federation fixture failures.

---

2. Merge commit: `62a8694b`.
3. All four subtasks are verified complete.
4. The master task remains open for direct operator closeout.
